title: policy.json: review
description: When a calibration review is due for a person (design part 23.4). It is due on evidence: enough new outcomes of that person's calls since their last review. An outcome is a recorded fact about how a call turned out: an overruled precedent application, a reversed call, a reverted merge the person approved, or a rating of whether a question was worth asking. `hitld cadence due` counts them from the trust record.

every_outcomes.description: Due once this many new outcomes have arrived for a person since their last review.

first_after_outcomes.description: Due for a person who has had no review yet once this many outcomes have arrived: fewer, so the first feedback comes early (design part 23.6).
